name: Fekr-e Palid
overview: Mr. Abdullah is a benevolent and kind man who owns an old printing house. In addition to supporting his brother Kamal, he also takes care of Yousef, a young man who lost all his family members in the earthquake, and Mr. Abdullah is saving money for his future. After starting work at the printing house, Yousef faces problems from those around him and jealousy in the workplace; events that affect the course of his life and those around him.
